note: Cases copy http_validation.rs (keyed_http_contract_is_the_call_service_one, keyed_http_rejects_statically_non_string_expressions, the beacon, page-facts and on-device key tests, the literal call-key unused tests), emit_config_validation.rs (cancelled_without_key_is_an_error, a_null_key_does_not_count_as_a_key, the non-string key literal tests, key_only_options_are_read_as_options_not_params) and host_effects_validation.rs (random_bytes_takes_a_string_key, the redis and postgres key tests), each with its control. A key whose type only inference decides (`(+ 1 2)`, a number-typed @config knob) is not decided here and stays in Rust; the call_service underscore spelling and oauth-authorize's key are not in the operator shapes. Expected findings carry the code, path, message and suggestion of the Rust validator, severity error.
